#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
pidfile=$base/run/worker.pid
lockfile=$base/run/control.lock
worker=$base/worker.py
action=${1-}
PID=
STATE=

process_is_worker()
{
    check_pid=$1
    [ -r "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" ] || return 1
    process_state=$(awk '/^State:/{print $2; exit}' "/proc/$check_pid/status" 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ "$process_state" != Z ] || return 1
    tr '\000' '\n' < "/proc/$check_pid/cmdline" | grep -Fqx -- "$worker"
}

classify_pidfile()
{
    PID=
    if [ ! -e "$pidfile" ]; then
        STATE=absent
        return
    fi
    if ! PID=$(cat -- "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null); then
        STATE=invalid
        return
    fi
    case $PID in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) STATE=invalid; return ;;
    esac
    if ! [ "$PID" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        STATE=invalid
        return
    fi
    if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        if process_is_worker "$PID"; then
            STATE=live
        else
            STATE=foreign
        fi
    else
        STATE=stale
    fi
}

mkdir -p -- "$base/run"
exec 9>"$lockfile"
flock -x 9

case $action in
    start)
        classify_pidfile
        case $STATE in
            live)
                printf 'worker already running (pid %s)\n' "$PID"
                exit 0
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'removing stale worker pid %s\n' "$PID"
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'pid %s belongs to another process; leaving it running\n' "$PID"
                ;;
            invalid)
                printf 'removing invalid worker pid file\n'
                ;;
            absent) ;;
        esac
        rm -f -- "$pidfile"
        /usr/bin/python3 "$worker" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
        new_pid=$!
        printf '%s\n' "$new_pid" > "$pidfile"
        sleep 0.2
        classify_pidfile
        if [ "$STATE" != live ] || [ "$PID" != "$new_pid" ]; then
            rm -f -- "$pidfile"
            printf 'worker failed to start\n' >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        printf 'worker started (pid %s)\n' "$new_pid"
        ;;
    stop)
        classify_pidfile
        case $STATE in
            live)
                old_pid=$PID
                kill "$old_pid"
                attempts=0
                while process_is_worker "$old_pid" && [ "$attempts" -lt 50 ]; do
                    sleep 0.1
                    attempts=$((attempts + 1))
                done
                if process_is_worker "$old_pid"; then
                    kill -KILL "$old_pid"
                fi
                rm -f -- "$pidfile"
                printf 'worker stopped (pid %s)\n' "$old_pid"
                ;;
            stale)
                rm -f -- "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed stale worker pid %s; no process was killed\n' "$PID"
                ;;
            foreign)
                rm -f -- "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed foreign pid %s; unrelated process left running\n' "$PID"
                ;;
            invalid)
                rm -f -- "$pidfile"
                printf 'removed invalid worker pid file; no process was killed\n'
                ;;
            absent)
                printf 'worker already stopped\n'
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    status)
        classify_pidfile
        case $STATE in
            live)
                printf 'worker running (pid %s)\n' "$PID"
                exit 0
                ;;
            stale)
                printf 'stale worker pid %s (not running)\n' "$PID"
                exit 1
                ;;
            foreign)
                printf 'pid %s belongs to another process (worker not running)\n' "$PID"
                exit 1
                ;;
            invalid)
                printf 'invalid worker pid file (worker not running)\n'
                exit 1
                ;;
            absent)
                printf 'worker stopped\n'
                exit 3
                ;;
        esac
        ;;
    *)
        printf 'usage: %s {start|stop|status}\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

install -o root -g root -m 0755 "$tmp" "$base/bin/control"
rm -f "$tmp"
printf 'INSTALLED\n'
sha256sum "$base/bin/control"
